message: You know that one friend who panics at the slightest hint of smoke? 🙈 Well, I might be that friend when it comes to fire safety! I recently stumbled upon some really helpful resources from the NFPA that break down home fire safety in a way that feels manageable and practical. It’s all about being prepared without getting overwhelmed. Remember, a little knowledge goes a long way! What’s your go-to tip for keeping things safe at home?
